objective_breakdown: stage2: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy caliber, electrolyte excluded) - expected to bind; SEI<=500nm@100cyc 1C - baseline ~449nm likely passes; SEI<=550nm@500cyc 1C - expected to bind (ec-limited growth keeps rising); lowT retention>=90% at -20C vs 25C - expected to bind (carbonate transport at 253K). stage3: 4C@45C charge without plating (anode_potential_v>=0), T_max monitored (no task threshold). Trade-offs: thick/dense electrodes raise ED but worsen 4C plating and low-T transport; high-conductivity electrolyte helps 4C+lowT with zero ED cost (electrolyte excluded from mass); SEI suppression has no ED/rate cost.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline characterization on Chen2020 (1C SPMe->DFN, calc-energy, lowT_discharge, 4C_charge_45C+plating, aging 100 and 500 cycles) + opening ceiling assessment; R2+ targeted architecture variants against measured gaps (thickness/porosity/N-P/CC/separator/particle size, proposed at relevant moments only - exploration_force OFF); escalate to Stage 2 formulation (electrolyte sigma/D/t+) and coating (SEI kinetic rate constant) candidates if ceiling assessment shows material bottleneck (ceiling_escalation ON); final round = full protocol battery on winner.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline+ceiling; R2-5 architecture sweep; R6-8 electrolyte transport + coating escalation; R9-10 aging-500 verification on finalists; R11 final candidate full battery + closing.
risk_and_fallback: lowT 90% may be transport-capped -> electrolyte sigma/D formulation bridge, thin electrodes, porosity; if unreachable after boundary-questioning -> honest negative result with reachable-point statement. ED 327.18 near NMC811/graphite practical ceiling (~320-350 Wh/kg, domain experience) -> thin CC (Al 10um/Cu 8um), thin separator, porosity 0.25-0.30, thickness balance; if below ceiling -> system-switch escalation recorded. SEI@500 -> SEI kinetic rate constant reduction (coating, ec-limited; signal-scale reference x0.1 kinetics -> 449->385nm@100cyc) + N/P increase; same-system comparison only. 4C plating -> negative particle radius down, N/P up, sigma up; plating judged mechanically from anode_potential_v. Aging trajectory climb-then-saturate artifact annotated honestly; SEI thickness is the reliable indicator.
